architecture.pipeline: CANON -> JSON/PS -> PARSER -> ADAPTIVE REPAIR -> AST/CANONICAL -> CANONICAL EQUIVALENCE -> WINDOWS BEHAVIOUR -> UAUD EVIDENCE -> UARD -> INSTALL
architecture.install_authority: UARD only after all validation gates pass

diagnostic_baseline.rule: collect complete stdout/stderr batch, evaluate structural/process evidence, then classify only strongest high-confidence evidence
diagnostic_baseline.false_positive_policy: ambiguous narrative mentions do not become diagnostic events
diagnostic_baseline.benchmark: force-first detector must reduce false positives without losing high-confidence positives

verification.functional_result: UAUD launch chain completed successfully on the real Windows client
verification.diagnostic_result: force-first diagnostic checker adopted after non-installing benchmark showed fewer false positives while retaining all high-confidence positives in the regression corpus
verification.diagnostic_note: Windows CI is the authoritative execution check; a CI failure caused by unrelated/pre-existing diagnostic syntax is not treated as evidence against the force-first algorithm itself.

baseline_rule: OSblocker 1.0.0 is the known-good functional floor. Future changes must preserve this behaviour and pass the validation/regression gates before becoming the next baseline.
